verdict.rationale: Yubico does have web APIs, including the YubiCloud OTP validation API and the YubiEnterprise REST API documented at console.yubico.com/apidocs/, so the axis applies. However, every OpenAPI/Swagger path probed returned 404, and the OTP API is documented only as a prose protocol; the evidence states no machine-readable spec exists for any Yubico API. Nothing shows the YubiEnterprise apidocs page offers a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
